action.sql: WITH ps AS (SELECT product_id, any_value(supplier_id) sup FROM purchase_order WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT ps.sup, date_trunc('month', c.date) m, c.reason, count(*) n, count(distinct c.product_id) prods FROM complaint c JOIN ps ON ps.product_id=c.product_id GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
